description: This pie chart illustrates a "Token Routing Distribution," as indicated by the partial title at the top. The chart is divided into a total of three slices. The largest segment, colored green and labeled "LOCAL" on the outside, accounts for 94.5% of the distribution. The second largest slice is colored red, labeled "LLM," and represents 3.9%. The smallest slice is colored blue, labeled "EDGE_P2P," and makes up 1.6%. The chart does not include a separate legend; instead, category labels are positioned just outside their respective segments, while the percentage values are displayed directly inside or adjacent to the slices in bold text. Visually, the two smaller slices—the red "LLM" segment and the blue "EDGE_P2P" segment—are emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the pie chart. The segments appear to be ordered by descending size in a counter-clockwise direction starting from the large green slice.
